local_checks.result: The two pull_request_target workflows check out the base SHA and execute trusted-base gate scripts with read-only tokens; PR metadata is API data. container-pr-smoke.yml:7-45 executes candidate code with contents:read. container-release.yml:28-55 restricts the publication job to eligible main/tag source and checks out exact github.sha. security-repository.yml guards privileged reporting for fork PRs. No source path transfers PR code into release credentials.

local_checks.invariant: Workflow metadata and operator inputs must remain data when passed to commands or workflow outputs.
local_checks.result: container-release.yml:377 bridges cleanup-source input through environment; shell paths/arguments are quoted. container-candidate/action.yml similarly bridges matrix values through environment. select-validation.mjs parses NUL-delimited Git changes and selection.mjs validates paths/source values. Promotion uses spawn argument arrays. container-vulnerability-gate/action.yml:49 interpolates artifact-prefix into shell, but all inspected callers provide fixed repository-controlled paths, so no lower-trust expression-injection chain was established.

local_checks.invariant: External issue comments and advisory bodies must not grant their authors control over scan execution or select privileged confidential-advisory updates without trusted automation ownership.
local_checks.result: The monitor workflow runs trusted main code with constrained job permissions, but :67-82 makes release selection depend on tracker preflight. monitor.mjs:849-853 loads all comments; release-issues.mjs:2489-2525 checks issue ownership labels yet sends every comment to marker parsers, where :169-175 throws for malformed reserved text and :2249-2261 never checks commenter identity. This gates off scans before synchronization recovery can run. Separately monitor.mjs:980-1058 checks private-reporting availability and uses a dedicated token but selects any advisory solely by a forgeable description marker before PATCH; author/collaborator ownership is not checked. Fingerprints at :540-546 are deterministic, not authenticators. dependency-drift.mjs:1018-1075 scopes mutation targets to labelled issues and reads comments as snapshots; :1183 onward still derives findings/deferrals from configured detection inputs. No separate lower-trust ability to label those issues or change configured deferrals was established. Source tests and operator documentation were read, not executed.

units.critic_reason: The monitor reads existing issues/advisories and matches descriptions by marker before updating private advisories at :1034-1050 with a dedicated token. The release publication units do not trace automation record ownership, allowable issue/advisory mutations, or authority inherited from external record bodies. Accept the hunter uncovered entry; inspect source only, with no GitHub writes or API checks.

local_checks.invariant: Migration/backfill must preserve owning identity and historical state rather than assign permissive defaults or enable an unsafe mixed-version rollback.
local_checks.result: Migration0026:12-33 validates HSA shape and copies the existing owner identity, rejecting null results; 0028:13-120 preserves live HSA assignment keys and adds person foreign keys instead of granting authority from placeholder names. 0031:1-18 refuses ownerless specifications rather than assigning a default owner. Migration0069:2-23 backfills validity from creation time without replacing specification ownership; new agreement tables start empty and current views filter time validity; down:143 refuses destructive history rollback. 0070 adds nullable terms and classifies only existing matching agreement-end evidence, never fabricating approvals/actors; down refuses rollback. Permission service:47 checks actual responsible/coauthor identities; agreement-policy:21-47 locks the actual specification and binds editable draft membership. Admin migration preflight/head checks:665-677 fail on incompatible histories. Upgrade guide:133 drains/stops apps and :567-570 requires full backup restore after migration, excluding mixed-reader/down-path rollback. No source-grounded ownership expansion found; migration failure/restart behavior was not executed.

units.critic_reason: Migration 0028 validates and consolidates live HSA identities while replacing assignment columns; 0031 changes required ownership; 0069 backfills valid_from, changes uniqueness to current rows and creates temporal views/owning-agreement relations. The only existing 0069 evidence cites current views for soft-delete behavior, not migration/backfill or supported rollback compatibility. No migration-default class is assigned although authorization consumes the transformed data. Trace preserved owner identity and immutable/historical state across supported migration modes.
